metadata.title: HOSS ReID dataset
metadata.description:
Hybrid Optical and Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) Ship Re-Identification Dataset (HOSS ReID dataset) is designed to evaluate the effectiveness of ship tracking using low-Earth orbit constellations of optical and SAR sensors. This approach ensures shorter re-imaging cycles and enables all-weather tracking. HOSS ReID dataset includes images of the same ship captured over extended periods under diverse conditions, using different satellites of different modalities at varying times and angles.

2025/07/11 Update: The pretraining data has been uploaded (pretrain_data.zip, pretrain_data.z01). It is constructed based on the SEN1-2 and DFC23 datasets.

Note: The complete dataset format description is provided in the readme.txt file within the compressed archive.

metadata.title: UEIKAP_DATASET
metadata.description:
UEIKAP is an open-source dataset for ship wake detection in satellite imagery, developed within the project “Unveil and Explore the In depth Knowledge of Earth Observation Data for Maritime Applications” (UEIKAP). This first release includes two subsets: (i) an optical dataset based on Sentinel-2 image chips with corresponding labels and AIS data, and (ii) a SAR dataset based on Sentinel-1 image chips with corresponding labels, JSON annotations, GeoTIFF images, and interpolated AIS data. The dataset is intended to support research on wake detection, maritime surveillance, and multimodal Earth Observation. In this version, the optical GeoTIFF folder is included as a placeholder and will be populated in a future update.

Acknowledgement: This dataset was developed within the UEIKAP project, funded by the Italian Ministry of Research and University under the Projects of Relevant National Interest (PRIN) program of 2022, CUP E53D23004300006.

documents.HOSS/readme.txt:
%****************************************************************************************************************%
% The HOSS ReID dataset is specifically designed for object tracking based on low-orbit remote sensing %
% constellations, emphasizing all-time, all-weather, and wide-area capabilities. It includes images from   %
% two modalities: SAR and optical.                                                                                                                         %
%****************************************************************************************************************%

Content in the Zip file:
1. "bounding_box_train" folder. This folder contains 1063 images for training.
2. "query" folder. It contains 176 query images. Search is performed in the "bounding_box_test" file.
3. "bounding_box_test" folder. This folder contains 593 images for testing.
4.  "subset" folder. It includes two subsets: Optical-to-SAR (O2S) and SAR-to-Optical (S2O). "O2S" means 
      that queries from the optical modality are searched only within the SAR modality gallery. "S2O" has a 
      similar meaning but in reverse.

%****************************************************************************************************************%

File name format:
[ObjectID]_s[SequenceID]c[FrameID]_[Modality].tif

Explanation:
1. ObjectID: Unique identifier for each ship object. A value of "-1" indicates a distractor (non-target object).
2. SequenceID: The dataset is constructed from 13 satellite image sequences; this ID denotes which 
                          sequence the crop belongs to.
3. FrameID: Indicates the position of this crop within its sequence (i.e., the frame number).
4. Modality: Either "RGB" (optical) or "SAR".

%****************************************************************************************************************%

Notes:
1. The number of each modality per object in the gallery is arbitrary.
2. In the training set, the distribution of modalities per object is also arbitrary, with a small proportion of 
    objects represented by images of only one modality.

# UEIKAP Dataset

Open-source dataset for ship wake detection in satellite imagery, developed within the UEIKAP project.

## Contents

```text
UEIKAP_dataset/
├── README.md
├── UEIKAP_dataset_optical/
│   ├── AIS_optical_UEIKAP/
│   ├── images/
│   ├── images_tif_TBD/
│   └── labels/
└── UEIKAP_dataset_SAR/
    ├── AIS_interpolated_SAR_UEIKAP/
    ├── images/
    ├── images_tifs/
    ├── labels/
    └── labels_jsons/
```

## Subsets

### Optical
- `images/`: optical image chips used for wake detection
- `labels/`: corresponding annotations
- `AIS_optical_UEIKAP/`: AIS data used for labeling and validation
- `images_tif_TBD/`: reserved for future GeoTIFF release; empty in this version

### SAR
- `images/`: SAR image chips used for wake and ship detection
- `labels/`: corresponding annotations
- `labels_jsons/`: annotation files in JSON format
- `AIS_interpolated_SAR_UEIKAP/`: interpolated AIS data used for labeling and validation
- `images_tifs/`: GeoTIFF SAR images

## Notes

- The dataset contains Sentinel-1 SAR and Sentinel-2 optical data prepared for ship wake detection tasks.
- AIS data are included in this release for labeling and validation purposes.
- The optical and SAR subsets are distributed separately because they differ in imaging physics, preprocessing, and annotation content.
- `images_tif_TBD/` in the optical subset is intentionally empty in this first public version and will be populated in a future update.

## Citation

If you use this dataset, please cite the associated UEIKAP dataset record and paper.

## Acknowledgement

Dataset developed within the UEIKAP project (*Unveil and Explore the In depth Knowledge of Earth Observation Data for Maritime Applications*).
